subject: Consortium pricing exception request — baseline hosted API rates
messages:
From: Catherine Li <catherine.li@educonsortium.org>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: StateU Procurement <procurement@stateu.edu>, Sarah Jones <sarah.jones@edufund.org>
Date: Thu, 15 Jan 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: baseline hosted-API rate exception for Western Academic Consortium

Hi Laura,

Thanks for taking a minute — I’m Catherine, program manager for the Western Academic Consortium (WAC). We’re evaluating Redwood for a multi-campus pilot (research search, automated summarization for syllabi, and course-embedding indexes). Before we get too far, procurement and our finance leads need clarification on baseline hosted-API unit rates and whether Redwood grants program/academic exceptions for consortia versus single university discounts.

High level:
- Pilot expected: 12 campuses, estimated 2M generation tokens/month during active term.
- We are a registered nonprofit consortium; attaching certificate.
- Ideal asks: eligibility for academic discount across the consortium, a short-term promotional credit to run evaluation workloads, and an option for a capped committed-spend rate for the pilot.

Can you share the standard EDU/consortium policy and whether exceptions (baseline rate adjustments) are possible for a committed pilot? If approval is needed, what’s the process and timeline?

Appreciate any guidance.

Catherine Li
Program Manager, WAC
W: educonsortium.org

Attachments: WAC_nonprofit_certificate.pdf
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Catherine Li <catherine.li@educonsortium.org>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 15 Jan 2026 11:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: baseline hosted-API rate exception for Western Academic Consortium

Hi Catherine — great to meet you and thanks for the context and the certificate. Looping in Rishi (sales lead for education) and Priyom (pricing/partner ops) so we can move quickly.

Short answers up front: we do have an education discount program but consortium exceptions are handled case-by-case when there’s a committed pilot or reserved capacity. Approvals depend on committed spend and product mix (generation vs embeddings). To help us evaluate: can you confirm expected monthly committed spend target if you were to secure a pilot rate (ballpark is fine), and whether you need a Hosted API-only path or a Dedicated proposal?

Next steps I propose:
1) We’ll prepare a short pricing memo outlining baseline EDU discount, proposed pilot rate, and required approvals.
2) If you can share a simple mutual action plan / timelines, we’ll include an optional promotional credit and implementation milestones.

I’ve attached a short worksheet we use to size pilots — if you could fill the 'monthly token volume' and 'target start date' fields that will speed review.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Senior Account Executive — Education & Nonprofit
Redwood Inference

Attachments: WAC_pricing_background_notes.xlsx
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Catherine Li <catherine.li@educonsortium.org>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 16 Jan 2026 08:33:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: baseline hosted-API rate exception for Western Academic Consortium

Thanks Laura — quick note from pricing side. We typically offer:
- Standard academic tier: 20% off list for verified single-institution EDU accounts (hosted API).
- Consortium / multi-campus exceptions: need a written commitment (3–12 months) and an expected monthly commit threshold to grant a deeper discount or a blended committed rate.

For a pilot size of ~2M tokens/month we could consider: 1) a promotional credit to validate technical fit (30–60 days), and 2) a narrow, pilot-specific rate adjustment (not a global rate change) if the consortium agrees to a short committed spend (example: $7.5k/mo for 6 months). Approvals needed: pricing manager signoff + finance for credits.

If WAC can commit to a minimum monthly spend, we can fast-track a 25% off baseline for the pilot term. Without commitment, we can still provide a 60-day $5k promo credit.

Priyom — can you outline compliance/paperwork required for consortium discounts?

-Rishi
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Catherine Li <catherine.li@educonsortium.org>
Date: Mon, 19 Jan 2026 09:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: baseline hosted-API rate exception for Western Academic Consortium

Hi all — logistics: for a consortium discount we need the following items before Finance can sign off on any one-off rate exception: 
- Signed MSA (standard Redwood EDU MSA acceptable) or an executed purchase order referencing the MSA;
- Billing entity (one campus or centralized org) and billing address;
- Verified nonprofit documentation (we received the certificate — thanks);
- Agreed mutual action plan (dates, acceptance criteria, pilot length);
- GL code / PO terms for those who require invoicing.

If you want the 25% pilot rate option Rishi mentioned, we’ll need a 6-month committed spend at a minimum of $7.5k/mo (net) and a short SOW referencing the pilot scope. If the consortium needs a lower commit, the alternative is: a 60-day $5k promotional credit + standard EDU discount (20%) during the pilot.

I’ve uploaded a one-page pricing proposal draft to the Drive link and put a sample PO template on the last tab of the spreadsheet.

-Priyom
From: Catherine Li <catherine.li@educonsortium.org>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: StateU Procurement <procurement@stateu.edu>, Sarah Jones <sarah.jones@edufund.org>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Jan 2026 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: baseline hosted-API rate exception for Western Academic Consortium

Laura / team — thanks, that is very helpful. Quick answers: 
- WAC prefers Hosted API for the pilot (no Dedicated at this point).
- We can commit to an initial pilot MRR target of $8k/mo for 6 months if that unlocks the deeper pilot rate.
- Acceptance criteria: integration with LMS search on 4 campuses, end-to-end embedding pipeline validated, and SLA for latency under 300ms p95 for serving queries during demo windows.
- Billing: StateU will act as billing entity for the pilot and can issue a PO.

We’ll prepare the PO and MSA review in parallel. Please go ahead and put together the pricing memo and the paperwork list you need so procurement can move quickly.

Best,
Catherine
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Request: baseline hosted-API rate exception for Western Academic Consortium

Catherine — fantastic, and thanks for the quick commit. Next steps from Redwood (I’ll own coordination):
1) I’ll send a one-page pricing memo by end of day confirming: pilot duration (6 months), committed MRR $8k, pilot-specific token rate (25% off list for the pilot term) and a $5k promotional credit applied at contract execution for usage overage protection.
2) Priyom will share the MSA and PO template and a checklist for procurement.
3) We’ll create a short mutual action plan doc with milestones and acceptance criteria for the LMS integration and embedding validation.

Tentative timeline: we can have a countersigned MSA + PO inside 7–10 business days if documents move quickly from your side. I’ll include the HubSpot deal link in the memo.

Sound good? I’ll follow up with the formal memo and the Drive link to the SOW.

Thanks again — looking forward to working with WAC.
